g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 30-minute reward before the reader chooses to play. The decline and ad-failure paths leave reading unchanged.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored stories, not cash or a transferable equivalent.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is progress through an article, not the content of anything a user wrote or said.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes no free reading, saving, or sharing feature; its reward temporarily hides sponsored cards.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a pop-up over s02 Article, which is rated content safe, rather than inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This product change adds a temporary ad-free reading window tied to f01, the observed read-a-story core flow.

c2_evidence.reason: The rationale claims the sponsored cards are low-value and hiding them displaces little revenue, neither of which the model establishes. The subscribers field also infers that every reader is free merely because no paid plan was observed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward lasts 30 minutes and is capped at two offers per day, so it is not an unlimited giveaway of a subscription benefit.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger and placement make a pop-up appear halfway through an article, interrupting reading without a limit hit, a tapped locked item, or a finished action.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a chosen sponsored game and grants the reward only once the play is confirmed. Progress through the article is an app-detectable event.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the s02 article reader and the sponsored cards observed in articles and the home feed.
